# Beacon - full text

Written by the product's own tooling, like llms.txt. Every page below is also served as a Markdown
twin, so an agent can read the site without a browser.

## Beacon

Beacon is a deploy CLI: it builds a site or a service, uploads the artifact, and records the release.

## Install

Beacon ships as a single binary: Homebrew, npm, or `go install`. The binary needs no runtime.

## Quickstart

`beacon init`, `beacon build`, `beacon deploy staging`. Each deploy is recorded, so
`beacon rollback` and `beacon releases` stay available.

## Configuration

`beacon.yml` holds `build`, `publish`, `environments`, and `hooks`. Flags, then environment
variables, then the file.

## Commands

`init`, `build`, `deploy`, `releases`, `rollback`, `status`. `--env`, `--dry-run`, `--json`.

## Output format

One line per step in text; `--json` prints one object per step with `step`, `status`, `seconds`,
and `detail`.

## CI integration

`beacon deploy production --json | tee beacon.json`; keep credentials in the secret store.

## Troubleshooting, security, FAQ

Timeouts come from a cold cache, `error: no credentials` from an unscoped secret, and an old site
from a target mismatch. Tokens come from `BEACON_TOKEN` and are never written to disk.

## Reference

Thirty generated pages, one per command, under /reference/.
